description:
Complete a soul inscription - STEP 2: Broadcast reveal transaction.

Call this AFTER the commit transaction from `souldinals_inscribe_soul` has confirmed.
Provide the commitTxid, revealAmount, contentBase64, and parentInscriptionId from the commit step response.

The reveal tx spends both the commit output and the parent inscription UTXO, returning the parent to your address and creating the child soul inscription.

Returns: inscriptionId ({revealTxid}i0) on success

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

commitTxid.description: Transaction ID of the confirmed commit transaction (from souldinals_inscribe_soul)

feeRate.description: Fee rate for reveal tx (default: medium)

parentInscriptionId.description: Parent inscription ID (must match the commit step)

revealAmount.description: Amount in the commit output (from souldinals_inscribe_soul response)

name: souldinals_reveal_soul
